  
**Registration Guidelines:**

* Registration fee is **200 tk.**  
* Any undergraduate university or college student can register.  
* There are no rank limits, players of any ranks can register  
* All players playing in the tournament must be registered through the provided Google Form.  
* The tournament format features head-to-head matches between individual players.  
* **Registration Deadline is July 03, 2026, 11:59 PM** 

**Reporting Time \- 09:00 AM**  
**Tournament Starts \- 10:00 AM**  
**Tournament Duration: 24-25 July 2026**  
**Tournament Location : IUT Campus**

**Mandatory Guidelines:**

* Players are required to report 1 hour before the event starts. Failure to comply may result in disqualification. (This is not a copy-paste rule. We will follow this strictly)  
* It's imperative that each player must carry their university student ID card for verification purposes. Ensure your eligibility by bringing your ID to the event.   
* All players participating in the event must bring their own headset and controller.

**Game:** EA FC 26  
**Platform:** PS4**/** PS5 / PC  
**Device:** ONLY CONTROLLERS are allowed.

**Format for FIfa:**  
The tournament consists of 64 players. **Round of 64 and 32 will be a direct knockout and from round of 16 it will be played as best of 3 format. The finals will be played as a best of 5 format.**

**Team Selection:** The participants are allowed to play with any team available.

### **Game Guidelines:**

Game mode: **Kick-off**  
Settings : **Standard Settings**  
Camera Angle: **Tele Broadcast height 20-0 zoom**  
Difficulty Level: **Legendary**  
Half Length: **6 minutes**  
Game Speed: **Normal**  
Injury : **Off**  
Season: **Fall/Autumn**  
Time of Day: **10:00 PM**  
Pitch Wear: **None**

* **Time wasting is not allowed before 80 minutes.**  
* **Tactical and advanced defending is allowed.**  
* **3-back and 5-back formations are banned.**  
* **It's forbidden to use custom formations, only the standard formations are allowed.**  
* **Should a match end in a draw after regulation time, extra time and penalties will follow to find an outright winner of the match.** 

**Match Results:**  
All matches will be coordinated by an organizer on duty.  
Match results will be recorded by the organizer.

**Time: 9 AM \- 5 PM for both days.**

**All players** will be in a **single bracket**  
All games **before** round of 16 will be **best of 1** and from round of 16 it will be **best of 3\. The finals will be played in the best of 5 format.**

![][image1]

**Before the match:**

**Check In:**  
Players should be available on the spot 15 minutes prior to their match time. The organizers or the observers will have the right to decide whether or not to allow a player to participate in that match.

**During the match:**

**Technical Timeout:**  
Players will only be allowed to take a timeout if there is a technical difficulty detected.

**Toxicity:**

To ensure a positive and respectful environment, NO TOXICITY is allowed and if noticed the player will get disqualified. Offensive Language might lead you to a ban from our tournament. It is essential for all participants to demonstrate good sportsmanship and cooperative behavior for a healthy competition.

**RuIes Changes:**

The Tournament administration reserves the right to amend, remove, or otherwise change the rules outlined in this Rulebook, without further notice. The Tournament administration also reserves the right to make a judgment on cases that are not specifically supported or detailed in this Rulebook or to make judgments that even go against this Rulebook in extreme cases, to preserve fair play and sportsmanship.
